stem: Which of the following is a recognized cause of death?
rationale: Death from starvation occurs when available energy reserves are depleted. Certain forms of malnutrition are associated with energy imbalance, such as marasmus. Thyroid hormones control the metabolic rate.

stem: What substance is ATP/ADP converted into?
rationale: The hydrolysis of the terminal phosphate of ATP, which converts ATP to ADP + Pi, serves as a reference point. High-energy phosphates include anhydrides like the 1-phosphate of 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate.

rationale: The high group transfer potential of ATP enables it to act as a donor of high-energy phosphate to form compounds listed in Table 11--1.
